name: Erwin Custom Fabrication
old_description: For over 28 years, Erwin Custom Fabrication has specialized in custom welding and metalwork in Nampa and across Idaho—precision-built for your needs.
about:
Erwin Custom Fabrication operates from Nampa, Idaho, where it was founded in 1993. The shop has served the Treasure Valley for over three decades, building a reputation for custom welding and metalwork across residential, commercial, and industrial projects.

The company provides a full range of fabrication services under one roof, including structural steel fabrication, welding of steel, aluminum, and stainless steel, sheet metal forming, laser cutting, and ornamental metalwork. Its project portfolio spans custom range hoods, gates and fences, metal cabinets, countertops, signage, sinks, wainscoting, stair and railing systems, and steel tanks for industrial use.

Erwin works with homeowners, builders, and commercial contractors throughout the Treasure Valley — including Nampa, Caldwell, Meridian, Boise, and surrounding mountain communities. Its customer base covers residential construction, commercial building, architectural metalwork, and foodservice equipment fabrication.

The shop emphasizes shop capacity over sales rhetoric, highlighting decades of experience, precision craftsmanship with tight fits and clean welds, and local accessibility for dependable communication and handoff.
